_meta.title: Home Query Fan-out Inventory
_meta.method: static analysis + EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) on production PostgreSQL 17
_meta.policy: Pure measurement — NO code changes, NO index additions, NO optimizations applied

summary.conclusion: DB-bound critical path is 1.17ms (1.75% of warm TTFB). Optimizing the database won't meaningfully improve home page TTFB. The bottleneck is JS render + serialization + network.

queries.prisma_call: db.brand.findMany({ where: { active: true }, orderBy: [{ featured: 'desc' }, { sortOrder: 'asc' }, { name: 'asc' }], include: { _count: { select: { listings: { where: { status: 'PUBLISHED' } } } } }, take: 20 })
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM "Brand" WHERE active=true ORDER BY featured DESC, "sortOrder" ASC, name ASC LIMIT 20
queries.notes: Phase 1 Promise.all parallel.

queries.prisma_call: db.category.findMany({ where: { active: true, layer: 'CATALOG' }, orderBy: [{ sortOrder: 'asc' }], include: { _count: { select: { listings: { where: { status: 'PUBLISHED' } } } } } })

A_PARALLEL.description: Independent queries already running via Promise.all (or candidates if currently sequential)

B_SEQUENTIAL_LEGITIMATE.description: Sequential with real data dependency — should NOT be parallelized

B_SEQUENTIAL_NEEDLESS.description: Sequential WITHOUT data dependency — Promise.all candidate
B_SEQUENTIAL_NEEDLESS.note: Tiny savings (0.027ms). Worth doing in 15-B.4 only if not too disruptive.

C_MERGE_CANDIDATE.description: Multiple count queries on same table — could be replaced by 1 FILTER aggregate

duplicate_pairs.predicate: Category WHERE parentId IS NULL AND active=true (Q10 adds layer='CATALOG' — near-duplicate)

C_MERGE_CANDIDATE.merge_strategy_candidate: Single SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ...) FROM table — would reduce 8 queries to ~3 (one per table)
C_MERGE_CANDIDATE.note: Prisma doesn't directly support FILTER aggregates — would need raw SQL or $queryRaw. Deferred to 15-B.4.

D_CONDITIONAL.description: Conditional / one-time queries — should NOT be mixed with read queries for fan-out analysis

comparison_to_actual_ttfb.conclusion: DB-bound critical path is 1.17ms (1.75% of warm TTFB). Optimizing the database alone won't meaningfully improve home page TTFB. The bottleneck is JS render + HTML serialization + network — addressed in 15-D (Frontend).

duplicate_count_queries_analysis.summary: 3 listing counts + 1 brand count + 1 category count are fired in Phase 4, and 3 of them are DUPLICATED in Phase 8 (via getActiveStats). This is a real duplication — not a guess.
phase_4_category_counts: Q10 (active=true AND parentId IS NULL AND layer='CATALOG')
phase_8_category_counts: Q23 (active=true AND parentId IS NULL — near-duplicate, omits layer filter)
duplicate_count_queries_analysis.merge_strategy: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='PUBLISHED') AS active, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='PUBLISHED' AND featured) AS featured, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='PUBLISHED' AND verified) AS verified FROM "Listing" — replaces Q8 + Q11 + Q12 + Q21 in 1 query
duplicate_count_queries_analysis.estimated_query_count_reduction: 8 queries → 3 queries (one per table: Listing, Brand, Category)
duplicate_count_queries_analysis.note: Tiny savings (0.366ms) — worthwhile only if combined with other improvements in 15-B.4. NOT applied here.
